title: 모음 ㅑ·ㅕ·ㅛ·ㅠ: 짧은 ‘y’를 더해서 읽기
objective: Read and say ㅑ, ㅕ, ㅛ, ㅠ as a quick 'y' plus ㅏ, ㅓ, ㅗ, ㅜ, and tell them apart from the plain vowels in 오리/요리 and 우리/유리.
summary: Add one short stroke to ㅏ, ㅓ, ㅗ, ㅜ and you get ㅑ, ㅕ, ㅛ, ㅠ: the same sounds with a quick 'y' in front. Practise 오리/요리 / and 우리/유리 and read easy everyday words.

task.title: 3 / YOUR TURN
task.line: Say each Korean word out loud first, then write or choose the answer.

words.exampleMeaning: There is a duck in the water.
This is our school. (우리 = we, our)

letters.as: like 'yo' in 'yoga', but a short, pure 'o' with no 'w' at the end

exercises: Add a short 'y' sound to each vowel and write the new letter: ㅏ, ㅓ, ㅗ, ㅜ
Choose the word that means 'duck': 오리 / 요리
Choose the word that means 'glass': 우리 / 유리
Write this word in Roman letters: 여우
Circle every word that has a y-vowel (ㅑ, ㅕ, ㅛ, ㅠ): 오리, 여기, 우리, 휴지
